text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O takes 1st! It's Sakura 
Chiyono O!!
(Waaaaaaaahhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Unconsumed by flames, strong cherry 
blossoms bloom.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
However... Yaeno-san's fighting spirit was 
like a dance of flames piercing straight 
into the sky in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Controlling that consciously is truly 
worthy of admiration.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I did it…… I DID ITTTTTTT!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Chiyono O!! That run was 
everything we hoped for!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you so much for your 
support!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
You're running in the Nippon Derby too, 
right? I'm really looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes!! I'll definitely win the Derby too!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Ghhh... AAAAAAAAGH!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Still green!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yaeno-san...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Tasting defeat and lamenting your 
frustration is a privilege reserved only 
for those who fought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As I am now, I am not even permitted to 
grieve.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"At the Japanese Derby, without fail. I 
want to shine brightly on the turf too."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: No matter what price must be paid.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Trainer-dono, I am truly ashamed.
choice_data_list: There's no need for you to apologize.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: However... even so!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: How pathetic!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to win... I wanted to dedicate 
this victory to Grandpa...!
choice_data_list: Let's win the next Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.text:
I vowed to dedicate myself even further 
for that very purpose.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Next time... Next time I'll win and 
prove it...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That the path I had walked was not a 
mistake.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Choosing races as a place to channel and 
elevate that fighting spirit, too.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That she had trained rigorously to master 
and control her fiery passion through 
"Unity of Fire and Water."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'll prove that I have grown by following 
the path Grandpa showed me!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: At the Japan Derby, without fail!!

Yaeno Muteki's earnest, gut-wrenching 
plea. Fulfilling it is precisely a 
Trainer's duty.
choice_data_list: Yeah! I promise I'll guide you to victory!
Yeah! I promise to guide you to the end!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Ossu!! I shall devote myself with all my 
might!"

Though her voice was choked with tears, 
Yaeno Muteki declared it with conviction.
